stance: Housing is weak but stabilising. Existing sales at 3.99M SAAR, up 1.5% after a 3.2% drop, stay near cycle lows. Closings lag, so the print says little about direction. No consensus was found, so beat or miss is unconfirmed. Watch permits and new home sales for a turn, and mortgage rates for affordability. A move above 4.1M would suggest recovery.
